'''Norbert's Courage''' (Japanese: '''ノゾムの勇気''' ''{{tt|Nozomu|Norbert}}'s Courage'') is the second chapter of [[Pokémon the Movie: The Power of Us: Zeraora's Story]].

==Plot==
{{incomplete plot}}

==Major events==
* {{OBP|Ash Ketchum|M20|Ash}} and [[Margo]] return to the simulation, but now view the events from the eyes of a boy named [[Dr. Hawthorn|Norbert]].
* Norbert is attacked by [[Agee]], but is saved by {{OBP|Zeraora|M21}}, who defeats the [[Pokémon hunter]]s and forces them to retreat.
* The {{pkmn|battle}} between Zeraora and Agee's {{p|Tyranitar}} ends up setting the area on fire.
* While Zeraora rescues the [[wild Pokémon]], Norbert tries to escape, only for his {{p|Elekid}} to get trapped under some falling tree branches.
* Norbert and Zeraora work together to rescue Elekid, but once they save it, a large explosion occurs and Elekid is nowhere to be seen.
* Angered at the apparent loss of Elekid, Zeraora lets out a loud roar, which summons {{OBP|Lugia|M21}}.
